import json
import openmdao.api as om
import pycycle.api as pyc

# Build the simple turbojet element
prob = om.Problem()

prob.model = pyo = pyc.CycleFlow()

# Add flight conditions
pyo.add('flight', pyc.FlightConditions())

# Add inlet, compressor, combustor, turbine, nozzle
pyo.add('inlet', pyc.Inlet())
pyo.add('comp', pyc.AXI5())
pyo.add('comb', pyc.Combustor())
pyo.add('turb', pyc.LPT2269())
pyo.add('noz', pyc.CD_nozzle())

# Mechanical shaft connecting turbine to compressor
pyo.add('shaft', pyc.Shaft())

# Connect flow paths
pyo.connect('flight.FL_I', 'inlet.Fl_I')
pyo.connect('inlet.Fl_O', 'comp.Fl_I')
pyo.connect('comp.Fl_O', 'comb.Fl_I')
pyo.connect('comb.Fl_O', 'turb.Fl_I')
pyo.connect('turb.Fl_O', 'noz.Fl_I')

# Connect mechanical shaft
pyo.connect('comp.trq', 'shaft.trq_in')
pyo.connect('turb.trq', 'shaft.trq_out')

# Set up thermodynamic cycle
pyo.pyc_add_cycle('shaft', {'comp': 'Nmech', 'turb': 'Nmech'})

# Balance shaft speed between compressor and turbine
pyo.add('shaft_eq', om.BalanceComp())
pyo.connect('shaft_eq.Nmech', ['comp.Nmech', 'turb.Nmech'])
pyo.connect('shaft.Nmech', 'shaft_eq.lhs')

# Setup the cycle thermodynamic properties
pyo.set_input_defaults('flight.FL_I', val=0., units='lbf')  # Thrust target
pyo.set_input_defaults('flight.alt', val=0., units='ft')
pyo.set_input_defaults('flight.MN', val=0.0)

# Inlet defaults
pyo.set_input_defaults('inlet.MN', val=0.0)

# Component-specific inputs
pyo.set_input_defaults('comp.MN', val=0.0)
pyo.set_input_defaults('turb.MN', val=0.4)

# Set up the propulsion equilibrium (thrust balance)
pyo"
